title: Transport
description: Departure or arrival of a consignment. Corresponds to the EPCIS ObjectEvent with action OBSERVE and bizStep shipping or receiving. Departure and arrival are two entries, usually issued by two different parties - the agreement between both statements is part of the evidence.

consignment.description: Identifier of the consignment, e.g. container or waybill number.

conditions.description: Carriage conditions promised. Whether they were kept is what the measurement entries say - not this field.
